clips.title: The story
paras: Gubber Blump and his heirloom Fishing Pole await a catch on Auberdine's docks. Hostile murlocs keep the town's small fishing boats ashore, so Gubber seeks help catching native Darkshore grouper from the coast.

Gubber Blump takes pride in a family known for its skill with a fishing line. Night elves make up most of Auberdine, though dwarves and gnomes have settled around its docks and port. Gubber spends his days gazing over the Veiled Sea instead of digging into stone, hoping to bring in the local catch.

Darkshore grouper thrive along the coast and make versatile food, but they can put up a lively fight on the line. Local fishermen usually row small boats into deeper waters to catch them. Now aggressive murlocs prowl the coast, and small boats no longer go out. Gubber fears the creatures are eating the local fish, so he asks travelers to fish from shore.

Gubber gives a Blump Family Fishing Pole to anyone who brings him a hearty catch. He believes anyone who can land a batch of feisty groupers is worthy of his family's legendary anglers, including his cousin Graun Blump. For Gubber, handing over a family rod is the highest mark of respect.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I love fishing. The Blump family is known for fishing. My name is Gubber Blump; I fish.

There's a kind of fish I like to catch around these parts called Darkshore grouper. I used to go out on a boat to fish for grouper, but no boats have been going out since them mean ol' murlocs moved in. I bet they been eating up all the grouper too.
Say, you wanna help me catch Darkshore grouper? I'd give you a bona fide Blump Family Fishing Pole if you did! It's a real good pole to catch fish with.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There's plenty of good dishes you use Darkshore groupers for. They're good to eat, but I think it's more fun catching them.
You caught any Darkshore groupers yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Them's some real nice groupers, friend! Thanks for helping me out!

You're at least as good of a fisherman as my cousin, Graun Blump. She also has a beard and she smells kinda funny, but that don't do nothing to stop her fishing. I reckon you have what it takes to use a Blump Family Fishing Pole.
